financials_krw_bn._disclosed_margin_note: The company prints an INTEGER operating margin. It is kept here exactly as printed and is never recomputed. Charts use the ratio computed from the two won amounts, because an integer loses up to 0.5pp and a quarter-on-quarter step built from integers can be a full point wrong.
financials_krw_bn._2021q4_note: 2021Q4 net income (3,320) and operating margin (34%) were published all along, in the FY2021 release's own earnings-table image, not in its prose. This page carried both as nulls until 2026-08-31 because the prose was read and the table was not. The four quarters now add to the 9,616 that same release prints as the full year, exactly. Corroborated a second way: the Korean sibling release prints these as plain text.
financials_krw_bn._backfill_2016_2020_note: The twenty quarters 2016Q1-2020Q4 were added on 2026-08-31 from each quarter's own newsroom release. Every figure is read off that release's embedded earnings table, not its prose: the prose rounds to two or three significant figures (it writes '5.4 trillion won' where the table prints 5,358) and for five quarters -- 2017Q2, 2017Q3, 2018Q1, 2018Q2, 2018Q3 -- it omits the operating margin the table prints. The table is the finer and the more complete of the two, and it is the one that satisfies the rounding identity: on prose values 2017Q4 computes to 49.50% against a printed 49%, while the table's 4,466/9,028 computes to 49.47%. All twenty are as-first-reported; comparative columns in later releases are not used. Cross-checked against a DIFFERENT corpus: SK hynix's statutory DART filings (사업보고서/분기보고서, corp code 00164779), which print the consolidated statements in KRW millions. DART discloses fifteen of these twenty quarters as discrete three-month figures, and all forty-five cells agree with the values here to the rounding (2016Q1 3,655.717 / 561.798 / 448.026 against 3,656 / 562 / 448, and so on). The five it does not cover are the Q4s: a Korean annual report prints the full year and the annual comparatives, never a discrete fourth quarter, so for those the company's own release is the only source and is what is used. Net income is the headline consolidated total INCLUDING non-controlling interests, which is what both corpora head with; owners'-share differs by single-digit billions a year (FY2019: 2,016.391 total against 2,013.288 owners').
financials_krw_bn._2022_precision_note: 2022Q1-Q3 were carried at the precision of the English release's PROSE (nearest 10bn for Q1 and Q2), and 2022Q3's operating profit and net income were the RESTATED vintage: 1,660.5 and 1,107.6 are what the 3Q2023 release prints in its year-ago column, not what 3Q2022 printed for itself. Its own release prints 16,556 and 11,027 억원 = 1,655.6 and 1,102.7, which is what is carried now, so every quarter on this page is as-first-reported without exception. All three quarters are now at the 억원 precision the Korean release table prints (news.skhynix.co.kr), read first-hand. 2022Q4 stays at whole billions on both vintages, because the restatement exhibit compares the two and the identity it rests on -- operating profit and net income moved by the SAME amount -- only holds when both sides are read at the same precision; the restated side was recorded whole.

restatement_2022q4._status: declared break, drawn on the page
restatement_2022q4.why: The series carries each quarter as the company first reported it, which is the only basis on which the four quarters of 2022 reconcile to the full year the company printed at the time. The restated fourth quarter is published beside it rather than swapped in: mixing the restated quarter into a series of first-reported quarters leaves an unresolvable residual in the first three, because SK hynix never republished those three.

restatement_census._what: Every quarter in 2016Q1-2022Q4 whose figures differ between its own release and a later release's comparative column. Built 2026-08-31 from the Korean-domain releases (news.skhynix.co.kr), which embed the comparison table as HTML text rather than as an image.
restatement_census._pattern: The revision never appears in the NEXT quarter's prior-quarter column -- that one repeats the original figure every time. It appears only in the year-ago column about four quarters later, i.e. after the external audit the releases' own disclaimer warns about ('prepared before the external auditor's review was completed'). No release ever uses the words restated / reclassified / corrected.
restatement_census._revenue: Revenue was never revised in 2016Q1-2020Q4. The only quarter whose revenue moved is 2022Q4, and that is also the largest revision of the five.

annual_audited_krw_bn._capex_definition: As printed in the filing: cash outflows for acquisition of property, plant and equipment, included in net cash used in investing activities. It excludes intangibles, and it is the same definition the cross-page capex table uses for the four cloud vendors.
annual_audited_krw_bn._operating_profit_identity: Operating profit is not a line in this K-IFRS presentation. It is gross profit less selling and administrative expenses less research and development. That identity reproduces the operating profit the company reports in its own releases exactly, for all three years and for Q1 2026.

half_year_capex_krw_bn._source: Form 6-K of 2026-08-18, condensed consolidated interim statements of cash flows, 'Acquisitions of property, plant and equipment', six-month columns (reviewed, not audited). Same definition as annual_audited_krw_bn.capital_expenditures: cash outflow for PP&E, intangibles excluded. The halves' revenue is not stored: it is the sum of the two quarters in financials_krw_bn, which the tests tie to the filing's six-month line.

revenue_by_product_krw_bn._source: Form 424B4 note 24(2) for the years and the interim note for 2025Q1 and 2026Q1 (audited years; Q1 interim reviewed). 2025Q2 and 2026Q2: Form 6-K of 2026-08-18, condensed consolidated interim statements note 21(2), three-month columns (reviewed, not audited): DRAM 56,982,743 / NAND Flash 21,959,898 / Others 376,105 and 17,123,990 / 4,727,806 / 380,156, KRW million.
revenue_by_product_krw_bn._note: A quarterly product split exists only where an interim statement prints a three-month column: 2025Q1 and 2026Q1 (the 424B4's Q1 interim) and 2025Q2 and 2026Q2 (the semi-annual 6-K). The six-month columns less the second quarter reproduce the 424B4's first-quarter cells (checked in the tests against `_checks`). No SEC-hosted filing read for this page carries 2023-2024 quarters or 2025Q3/Q4.

customer_concentration._source: Form 424B4 note 4(2) for FY2023-FY2025 (audited) and the Q1 interim note 4(2) for 2025Q1 and 2026Q1; Form 6-K of 2026-08-18 note 4(2) for the six months to 2025-06-30 and 2026-06-30 (reviewed). Periods run in order of their end date. Each filing labels its own customers 'A' and 'B' per period, so no line here says two periods' 'A' is one customer.
customer_concentration.fy2023_text: For the year ended December 31, 2023, no revenue derived from a single customer reached over 10% of the Group's revenue.

revenue_by_selling_entity_krw_bn._caveat: Based on the location of the SELLING ENTITY, not the customer. It says where SK hynix books the sale, not where the demand is.

below_operating_profit_krw_bn._source: Form 6-K filed 2026-07-29 (preliminary results table) for the three rows; the components are from the Form 6-K of 2026-08-18 (semi-annual report): consolidated interim statement of comprehensive income, note 24 (finance income and expenses) and note 25 (other income and expenses), three-month columns. The quarter's newsroom release stops at net income.
below_operating_profit_krw_bn._derived_note: Tax and the non-operating total are differences between two printed lines. The components are the semi-annual report's own lines for the quarter; four are nets of a printed income line and a printed expense line (marked derived). They add to pre-tax less operating profit to the million won. The report does not say which investment the valuation gain and the dividend came from, and none is named here.

kpi_phrases._source: Form 424B4 (2026-07-10): thirteen quarters, 1Q 2023 to 1Q 2026, as a table. 2Q 2026: the Form 6-K of 2026-08-18 (semi-annual business report for January-June 2026, section II.2.B 'Price Trends for Major Products'), which states the same four quarter-on-quarter changes in prose -- see _later_quarter_texts for the words and how each was entered in the table's vocabulary.
kpi_phrases._the_finding: These are the two quantities whose product is revenue, and SK hynix publishes both of them as English adjectives. It did so in its registration statement, in the same document that reports revenue to the million won.
kpi_phrases._mapping_status: The interval assigned to each phrase is this page's reading, not a company number. Four phrases are one-sided in the filing -- Over 20%, Over 30%, Over 40% and Over 70% -- and have no upper bound at all; each is capped ten points above its floor here so that it can be drawn, and the cap is a drawing convention, not a disclosure.

_later_quarter_texts.2Q 2026: Filed wording (6-K 2026-08-18, II.2.B): 'DRAM shipment volume increased slightly as sales expanded centered on HBM3E and AI-oriented server DRAM products, and average selling price (“ASP”) rose in the mid-30% range due to the continuation of strong pricing for general DRAM. NAND shipment volume increased in the mid-10% range compared to the previous quarter due to the base effect from the decline in shipments in the first quarter and the impact of expanded eSSD sales, and ASP rose in the mid-50% range compared to the previous quarter due to the effect of price increases across all products.' Entered as: increased slightly -> Slight Increase; mid-30% range -> Mid-30% Increase; mid-10% range -> Mid-teen% Increase (the 424B4 table's spelling of the same Korean bucket); mid-50% range -> Mid-50% Increase. The 2Q26 earnings call (2026-07-29) worded two of the four differently -- DRAM bit shipments 'high single-digit', DRAM ASP 'approximately 30%' -- see quarter_story.call_words.
